explanationEn: The two operations are distinct: an incoming frame’s source MAC teaches the MAC-to-port table, and destination MAC selects the output port. An ordinary Layer 2 switch does not build IP routes from frames or forward based on unknown IPs; learning from destination MAC would not reveal the sender’s location.

prompt: What action will occur if a switch receives a frame and does have the source MAC address in the MAC table?
options: The switch refreshes the timer on that entry.
The switch adds it to its MAC address table associated with the port number.
The switch forwards the frame to the associated port.
The switch sends the frame to a connected router because the destination MAC address is not local.
answers: The switch refreshes the timer on that entry.
answerText: The switch refreshes the timer on that entry..
explanation: Поскольку source MAC уже есть в таблице, новый кадр подтверждает активность устройства и обновляет таймер записи (при смене порта также обновляется порт). Новый адрес добавляют только если он ещё неизвестен. Пересылка определяется destination MAC, а не самим фактом известного source MAC.
explanationEn: An already-known source MAC refreshes its entry’s age timer because the device has been seen again; a changed ingress port can also update the mapping. A new entry is needed only for an unknown source. Forwarding depends on destination MAC, not merely on a known source.

prompt: Which statement describes the treatment of ARP requests on the local link?
options: They must be forwarded by all routers on the local network.
They are received and processed by every device on the local network.
They are dropped by all switches on the local network.
They are received and processed only by the target device.
answers: They are received and processed by every device on the local network.
answerText: They are received and processed by every device on the local network..
explanation: ARP request находится в Ethernet broadcast-кадре, поэтому все устройства локального broadcast domain принимают и проверяют запрос. Отвечает только владелец target IPv4 в обычном сценарии. Switch не отбрасывает такой кадр, а router не переносит его broadcast на другие интерфейсы.
explanationEn: An ARP request is carried in an Ethernet broadcast frame, so local broadcast-domain devices receive and examine it. Normally only the target IPv4 owner replies. A switch forwards the broadcast; a router does not propagate it out other interfaces.

prompt: Under which two circumstances will a switch flood a frame out of every port except the port that the frame was received on? (Choose two.)
options: The frame has the broadcast address as the destination address.
The destination address is unknown to the switch.
The source address in the frame header is the broadcast address.
The source address in the frame is a multicast address.
The destination address in the frame is a known unicast address.
answers: The frame has the broadcast address as the destination address.
The destination address is unknown to the switch.
answerText: The frame has the broadcast address as the destination address.; The destination address is unknown to the switch..
explanation: Flood нужен для destination broadcast (получатели все) и unknown destination unicast (порт получателя ещё неизвестен). Известный unicast отправляется по найденному порту. Source broadcast/multicast не является нормальным адресом отправителя Ethernet и не служит правилом выбора flood. Все действия ограничены VLAN и исключают входной порт.
explanationEn: Flooding is needed for destination broadcast (all recipients) and unknown destination unicast (recipient port not learned). Known unicast uses its learned port. Broadcast/multicast source addresses are not normal Ethernet source addresses and are not flooding criteria. Flooding stays within the VLAN and excludes ingress.

prompt: Refer to the exhibit. The exhibit shows a small switched network and the contents of the MAC address table of the switch. PC1 has sent a frame addressed to PC3. What will the switch do with the frame?
options: The switch will discard the frame.
The switch will forward the frame only to port 2.
The switch will forward the frame to all ports except port 4.
The switch will forward the frame to all ports.
The switch will forward the frame only to ports 1 and 3.
answers: The switch will forward the frame to all ports except port 4.
answerText: The switch will forward the frame to all ports except port 4..
explanation: Ключ «все порты, кроме 4» предполагает, что кадр пришёл на порт 4, а MAC PC3 отсутствует в таблице: unknown unicast рассылается на остальные подходящие порты VLAN. Если MAC PC3 известен, используется только его порт. Без исходной схемы и таблицы эти предпосылки проверить нельзя.
caution: Нужны схема и MAC-таблица: входной порт 4 и отсутствие PC3 в таблице не проверены.
explanationEn: “All ports except port 4” assumes ingress is port 4 and PC3’s MAC is unknown, causing unknown-unicast flooding to the other eligible VLAN ports. If PC3 is known, only its learned port is used. The original exhibit/table is required to verify those assumptions.

prompt: A network technician issues the arp -d * command on a PC after the router that is connected to the LAN is reconfigured. What is the result after this command is issued?
options: The current content of the ARP cache is displayed.
The detailed information of the ARP cache is displayed.
The ARP cache is synchronized with the router interface.
explanation: В arp -d * ключ -d означает delete, а * выбирает записи для очистки. После перенастройки роутера это убирает устаревшие IPv4→MAC соответствия, и при следующей передаче они изучаются заново. Команда не отображает кэш (-a) и не синхронизирует его с роутером.
explanationEn: In arp -d *, -d means delete and * selects the entries to clear. This removes stale IPv4-to-MAC mappings after router reconfiguration, allowing fresh resolution on subsequent traffic. It neither displays the cache (-a) nor synchronizes it with the router.

prompt: Refer to the exhibit. PC1 attempts to connect to File_server1 and sends an ARP request to obtain a destination MAC address. Which MAC address will PC1 receive in the ARP reply?
options: the MAC address of the G0/0 interface on R1
the MAC address of the G0/0 interface on R2
answers: the MAC address of the G0/0 interface on R1
answerText: the MAC address of the G0/0 interface on R1.
explanation: Ответ R1 G0/0 верен при условии, что File_server1 находится в другой подсети, а G0/0 R1 — локальный gateway PC1. Тогда ARP запрашивает MAC шлюза, не удалённого сервера, R2 или коммутатора. Исходная схема не приложена к карточке, поэтому этот выбор интерфейса условный.
caution: Нужна схема: расположение File_server1 и локального gateway PC1 не подтверждено.
explanationEn: R1 G0/0 is correct if File_server1 is off-subnet and R1 G0/0 is PC1’s local gateway. ARP then resolves that gateway, not the remote server, R2 or a switch. The exhibit is absent from the card, so the interface choice remains conditional.

prompt: What important information is examined in the Ethernet frame header by a Layer 2 device in order to forward the data onward?
explanation: Destination MAC — поле, по которому L2-устройство выбирает порт пересылки. Source MAC используется для обучения таблицы, EtherType сообщает протокол полезной нагрузки, а source/destination IP находятся в сетевом пакете и не являются ключом обычной Ethernet-коммутации.
explanationEn: Destination MAC selects the Layer 2 forwarding port. Source MAC teaches the table; EtherType identifies the payload protocol. Source/destination IP are network-packet fields rather than the key for ordinary Ethernet switching.

prompt: What statement describes the function of the Address Resolution Protocol?
options: ARP is used to discover the IP address of any host on a different network.
ARP is used to discover the IP address of any host on the local network.
ARP is used to discover the MAC address of any host on a different network.
ARP is used to discover the MAC address of any host on the local network.
answers: ARP is used to discover the MAC address of any host on the local network.
answerText: ARP is used to discover the MAC address of any host on the local network..
explanation: ARP узнаёт MAC локального IPv4-соседа по уже известному IPv4. Он не ищет IP неизвестного устройства и не переносит запрос через роутеры в чужую сеть. Для удалённой сети разрешается MAC своего шлюза, который находится локально.
explanationEn: ARP discovers a local IPv4 neighbor’s MAC from its already-known IPv4 address. It does not discover an unknown IP or carry requests through routers into remote networks. Off-subnet traffic resolves the local gateway’s MAC instead.

prompt: What property of ARP forces all Ethernet NICs to process an ARP request?
options: The destination MAC address FF-FF-FF-FF-FF-FF appears in the header of the Ethernet frame.
The source MAC address appears in the header of the Ethernet frame.
The type field 0x806 appears in the header of the Ethernet frame.
ARP replies are broadcast on the network when a host receives an ARP request.
answers: The destination MAC address FF-FF-FF-FF-FF-FF appears in the header of the Ethernet frame.
answerText: The destination MAC address FF-FF-FF-FF-FF-FF appears in the header of the Ethernet frame..
explanation: Именно destination FF-FF-FF-FF-FF-FF заставляет Ethernet NIC принять broadcast-кадр. Source MAC только обозначает отправителя; EtherType 0x0806 после приёма сообщает, что внутри ARP, но сам не делает кадр адресованным всем. Обычный ARP reply — unicast, не broadcast.
explanationEn: Destination FF-FF-FF-FF-FF-FF makes Ethernet NICs accept the broadcast frame. Source MAC merely identifies the sender; EtherType 0x0806 identifies ARP after reception but does not make the frame addressed to everyone. An ordinary ARP reply is unicast.

prompt: Which destination address is used in an ARP request frame?
options: the physical address of the destination host
explanation: FFFF.FFFF.FFFF — Ethernet broadcast, нужный потому, что MAC искомого IPv4 ещё неизвестен. 0.0.0.0 и 255.255.255.255 относятся к IPv4, а поле destination в кадре требует MAC. AAAA.AAAA.AAAA не является broadcast; уже известный физический адрес цели устранил бы необходимость обычного запроса.
explanationEn: FFFF.FFFF.FFFF is Ethernet broadcast, used because the target IPv4’s MAC is still unknown. 0.0.0.0 and 255.255.255.255 are IPv4 values, while a frame destination requires MAC. AAAA.AAAA.AAAA is not broadcast; an already-known target MAC would avoid the ordinary lookup.

prompt: Refer to the exhibit. PC1 issues an ARP request because it needs to send a packet to PC3. In this scenario, what will happen next?
options: RT1 will forward the ARP request to PC3.
RT1 will send an ARP reply with its own Fa0/0 MAC address.
RT1 will send an ARP reply with the PC3 MAC address.
SW1 will send an ARP reply with its Fa0/1 MAC address.
RT1 will send an ARP reply with its own Fa0/1 MAC address.
answers: RT1 will send an ARP reply with its own Fa0/0 MAC address.
answerText: RT1 will send an ARP reply with its own Fa0/0 MAC address..
explanation: Сохранённый ответ Fa0/0 RT1 требует, чтобы PC3 был удалённым, а Fa0/0 RT1 — локальным gateway PC1. Роутер отвечает своим MAC на запрос о своём IP; не пересылает ARP-broadcast к PC3 и не возвращает удалённый PC3 MAC. Без схемы нельзя подтвердить выбор Fa0/0 вместо Fa0/1.
caution: Нужна схема: локальный интерфейс RT1 и подсеть PC3 не подтверждены.
explanationEn: The saved RT1 Fa0/0 answer assumes PC3 is remote and RT1 Fa0/0 is PC1’s local gateway. The router replies with its own MAC for its own IP; it does not forward ARP broadcast to PC3 or return PC3’s remote MAC. The missing exhibit prevents verifying Fa0/0 versus Fa0/1.

prompt: Match the header field with the appropriate layer of the OSI model. FCS (frame check sequence) Layer 2 802.2 header destination MAC address source IP address Layer 3 TTL destination port number Layer 4 Acknowledgement number
answerText: Layer 2 → FCS, 802.2 header, destination MAC; Layer 3 → source IP, TTL; Layer 4 → destination port, acknowledgement number.
explanation: FCS проверяет кадр, 802.2 описывает LLC, destination MAC адресует канал — это Layer 2 (FCS технически находится в trailer, не header). Source IP и TTL относятся к IP-пакету, Layer 3. Destination port выбирает приложение, TCP acknowledgment отслеживает ожидаемые байты — Layer 4.
caution: Ответ
explanationEn: FCS checks the frame, 802.2 describes LLC and destination MAC addresses the link: Layer 2 (FCS is technically in the trailer, not header). Source IP and TTL belong to the Layer 3 IP packet. Destination port selects an application and TCP acknowledgment tracks expected bytes at Layer 4.

prompt: Refer to the exhibit. PC1 issues an ARP request because it needs to send a packet to PC2. In this scenario, what will happen next?
options: PC2 will send an ARP reply with its MAC address.
RT1 will send an ARP reply with its Fa0/0 MAC address.
RT1 will send an ARP reply with the PC2 MAC address.
SW1 will send an ARP reply with the PC2 MAC address.
SW1 will send an ARP reply with its Fa0/1 MAC address.
answers: PC2 will send an ARP reply with its MAC address.
answerText: PC2 will send an ARP reply with its MAC address..
explanation: Ответ PC2 предполагает, что PC1 и PC2 находятся в одной подсети. Тогда target IPv4 в ARP принадлежит PC2, и именно он отвечает своим MAC; switch лишь переносит кадры, а gateway не отвечает вместо обычного локального получателя. Без схемы общую подсеть нельзя проверить.
caution: Нужна схема: общая подсеть PC1 и PC2 не подтверждена.
explanationEn: PC2 is the answer if PC1 and PC2 share a subnet. The ARP target IPv4 then belongs to PC2, which replies with its own MAC; a switch merely forwards and the gateway does not normally answer for that local host. The missing exhibit prevents confirming the shared subnet.

prompt: Which two statements are correct about MAC and IP addresses during data transmission if NAT is not involved? (Choose two.)
options: A packet that has crossed four routers has changed the destination IP address four times.
Destination MAC addresses will never change in a frame that goes across seven routers.
Destination and source MAC addresses have local significance and change every time a frame goes from one LAN to another.
Destination IP addresses in a packet header remain constant along the entire path to a target host.
Every time a frame is encapsulated with a new destination MAC address, a new destination IP address is needed.
answers: Destination and source MAC addresses have local significance and change every time a frame goes from one LAN to another.
Destination IP addresses in a packet header remain constant along the entire path to a target host.
answerText: Destination and source MAC addresses have local significance and change every time a frame goes from one LAN to another.; Destination IP addresses in a packet header remain constant along the entire path to a target host..
explanation: Без NAT destination IP обозначает конечного получателя и остаётся тем же на маршруте. MAC действует только на текущем Ethernet-канале: роутер снимает старую оболочку и создаёт новую со своим исходящим MAC и MAC следующего соседа. Поэтому изменение MAC не требует изменения IP, а количество роутеров не равно количеству замен destination IP.
explanationEn: Without NAT, destination IP identifies the final recipient and remains unchanged along the route. MAC addresses apply only to the current Ethernet link: each router replaces the frame with its outgoing MAC and the next neighbor’s MAC. A new MAC does not require a new IP, and router count does not imply destination-IP changes.

prompt: What are two features of ARP? (Choose two.)
options: If a host is ready to send a packet to a local destination device and it has the IP address but not the MAC address of the destination, it generates an ARP broadcast.
An ARP request is sent to all devices on the Ethernet LAN and contains the IP address of the destination host and its multicast MAC address.
When a host is encapsulating a packet into a frame, it refers to the MAC address table to determine the mapping of IP addresses to MAC addresses.
If no device responds to the ARP request, then the originating node will broadcast the data packet to all devices on the network segment.
If a device receiving an ARP request has the destination IPv4 address, it responds with an ARP reply.
answers: If a host is ready to send a packet to a local destination device and it has the IP address but not the MAC address of the destination, it generates an ARP broadcast.
If a device receiving an ARP request has the destination IPv4 address, it responds with an ARP reply.
answerText: If a host is ready to send a packet to a local destination device and it has the IP address but not the MAC address of the destination, it generates an ARP broadcast.; If a device receiving an ARP request has the destination IPv4 address, it responds with an ARP reply..
explanation: Если у локального IPv4 нет записи в ARP-кэше, отправитель рассылает запрос; владелец target IPv4 отвечает — это два верных действия. Запрос не содержит уже известный multicast MAC цели. IPv4→MAC ищут в ARP-кэше, а не MAC→порт таблице switch. Без ответа отправитель не превращает сам пакет данных в broadcast: после неуспешного разрешения доставка не состоится.
explanationEn: With no cached MAC for a local IPv4, the sender broadcasts an ARP request and the target IPv4 owner replies: these are the two correct actions. The request does not contain a known target multicast MAC. IP-to-MAC lookup uses ARP cache, not the switch’s MAC-to-port table. Failure to resolve does not turn the data packet into broadcast; delivery ultimately fails.

prompt: A user sends an HTTP request to a web server on a remote network. During encapsulation for this request, what information is added to the address field of a frame to indicate the destination?
options: the MAC address of the destination host
the network domain of the destination host
the MAC address of the default gateway
the IP address of the default gateway
answers: the MAC address of the default gateway
answerText: the MAC address of the default gateway.
explanation: Вопрос спрашивает адрес в Ethernet-кадре, а сервер находится в удалённой сети: первый кадр адресуют MAC default gateway. IP сервера остаётся в IP-пакете. IP шлюза не помещается в поле MAC, доменное имя разрешается раньше через DNS, а MAC удалённого сервера не используется на первом локальном канале.
explanationEn: The question asks for the Ethernet-frame destination, and the server is off-subnet: the first frame targets the default gateway’s MAC. The server IP stays in the IP packet. The gateway IP cannot fill a MAC field, DNS resolves the domain earlier, and the remote server’s MAC is not used on the first local link.

prompt: Which IOS mode allows access to all commands and features?
explanation: Privileged EXEC (#) даёт полный административный доступ и позволяет перейти к конфигурации через configure terminal. User EXEC (>) ограничен мониторингом; global/interface/line configuration — отдельные режимы изменения настроек. «Все команды» в формулировке означает полный доступ к возможностям, а не возможность вводить любую команду прямо в приглашении #.
explanationEn: Privileged EXEC (#) grants full administrative access and permits entry to configuration through configure terminal. User EXEC (>) offers limited monitoring; global/interface/line configuration are specific editing modes. “All commands” means access to all capabilities, not that every configuration command is entered directly at the # prompt.

prompt: Which IOS mode are you in if the Switch(config)# prompt is displayed?
explanation: Маркер (config) в Switch(config)# обозначает global configuration: здесь меняют настройки устройства в целом. Голый # — privileged EXEC, > — user EXEC; (config-if) и (config-line) означали бы интерфейс и линию соответственно.
explanationEn: The (config) marker identifies global configuration, where device-wide settings are changed. A bare # indicates privileged EXEC and > user EXEC; interface and line modes would show (config-if) and (config-line).

prompt: Which IOS mode are you in if the Switch> prompt is displayed?
explanation: Знак > без (config) — user EXEC, начальный режим с ограниченными командами просмотра. После enable приглашение станет Switch#; при входе в настройку появится (config)#. Поэтому ни privileged EXEC, ни режимы конфигурации здесь не подходят.
explanationEn: A > prompt without (config) identifies user EXEC, the initial mode with limited monitoring commands. enable changes it to Switch#; configuration adds (config)#. Thus neither privileged EXEC nor a configuration mode matches this prompt.

prompt: Which two commands would return you to the privileged EXEC prompt regardless of the configuration mode you are in? (Choose two.)
explanation: end и Ctrl+Z сразу завершают любую вложенную конфигурацию и возвращают к privileged EXEC (#). exit поднимает только на один уровень; enable предназначен для перехода из user EXEC, а disable понижает privileged EXEC до user EXEC.
explanationEn: end and Ctrl+Z leave any nested configuration mode and return directly to privileged EXEC (#). exit moves up only one level; enable elevates user EXEC, while disable drops privileged EXEC to user EXEC.

prompt: What is the command to assign the name “Sw-Floor-2” to a switch?
explanation: В global configuration команда hostname принимает новое имя одним аргументом: hostname Sw-Floor-2. Ключевое слово пишется слитно; host name и name не являются этим синтаксисом IOS. Имя изменит префикс приглашения, но не режим CLI.
explanationEn: In global configuration, hostname takes the new name as its argument: hostname Sw-Floor-2. The keyword is one word; host name and name are not this IOS syntax. It changes the prompt name without changing CLI mode.

prompt: How is the privileged EXEC mode access secured on a switch?
explanation: enable secret class задаёт секрет для перехода по enable в privileged EXEC; class здесь учебное значение пароля. enable class и secret class имеют неверный синтаксис. service password-encryption скрывает уже заданные открытые пароли, но само не задаёт пароль privileged EXEC.
explanationEn: enable secret class sets the secret required when using enable to enter privileged EXEC; class is the sample password. enable class and secret class are invalid syntax. service password-encryption obscures existing plaintext passwords but does not itself set the privileged EXEC password.

prompt: Which is the command to configure a banner to be displayed when connecting to a switch?
explanation: Правильный синтаксис — banner motd, затем одинаковый разделитель до и после текста: $ Keep out $. IOS показывает этот текст при подключении. Остальные варианты не содержат корректного ключевого слова motd/синтаксиса banner; сообщение само по себе не проверяет пароль.
explanationEn: The syntax is banner motd followed by the same delimiter before and after the text: $ Keep out $. IOS displays it on connection. The alternatives lack the correct motd/banner syntax; the message itself performs no authentication.

prompt: What type of interface has no physical port associated with it?
explanation: SVI — программный интерфейс VLAN, поэтому отдельного разъёма у него нет. Он представляет коммутатор в IP-сети для управления. Console, Ethernet и Serial в этих вариантах относятся к физическим подключениям.
explanationEn: An SVI is a software VLAN interface and therefore has no dedicated physical connector. It gives the switch an IP presence for management. Console, Ethernet and Serial in these choices refer to physical connections.

prompt: Which statement is true about the running configuration file in a Cisco IOS device?
options: It affects the operation of the device immediately when modified.
It should be deleted using the erase running-config command.
It is automatically saved when the router reboots.
answers: It affects the operation of the device immediately when modified.
answerText: It affects the operation of the device immediately when modified..
explanation: running-config — активная конфигурация в RAM: корректная команда изменяет работу устройства сразу. NVRAM хранит startup-config, а не running-config. Перезагрузка не сохраняет изменения автоматически; их сохраняют copy running-config startup-config.
explanationEn: running-config is the active configuration in RAM, so a valid change affects operation immediately. NVRAM stores startup-config, not running-config. Rebooting does not automatically save changes; copy running-config startup-config does.

prompt: Which two statements are true regarding the user EXEC mode? (Choose two.)
options: Global configuration mode can be accessed by entering the enable command.
The device prompt for this mode ends with the '>' symbol.
Interfaces and routing protocols can be configured.
Only some aspects of the router configuration can be viewed.
answers: The device prompt for this mode ends with the '>' symbol.
Only some aspects of the router configuration can be viewed.
answerText: The device prompt for this mode ends with the '>' symbol.; Only some aspects of the router configuration can be viewed..
explanation: У user EXEC приглашение заканчивается > и доступна лишь часть команд просмотра. enable переводит в privileged EXEC, не сразу в global configuration; для последнего затем нужен configure terminal. Интерфейсы и routing protocols из user EXEC не настраиваются.
explanationEn: User EXEC ends in > and permits only limited inspection. enable enters privileged EXEC, not global configuration directly; configure terminal is then required. Interfaces and routing protocols cannot be configured from user EXEC.

prompt: Which type of access is secured on a Cisco router or switch with the enable secret command?
explanation: enable secret защищает повышение прав до privileged EXEC. Console, AUX и VTY — другие точки входа: их аутентификация задаётся в line configuration (login/password либо login local). Наличие enable secret не заменяет пароль входа на эти линии.
explanationEn: enable secret protects elevation to privileged EXEC. Console, AUX and VTY are separate entry points whose authentication is configured under line configuration using login/password or login local. An enable secret does not replace line login authentication.

prompt: What is the default SVI on a Cisco switch?
explanation: В базовом состоянии учебного Cisco-коммутатора SVI связан с VLAN 1. VLAN 99, 100 или 999 могут быть выбраны администратором для управления, но не являются значением по умолчанию. Наличие VLAN 1 ещё не означает настроенный IP или доступность управления.
explanationEn: The default SVI in the course switch configuration is VLAN 1. An administrator can choose VLAN 99, 100 or 999 for management, but these are not the default. VLAN 1 existing does not itself imply a configured IP or working remote management.

prompt: When a hostname is configured through the Cisco CLI, which three naming conventions are part of the guidelines? (Choose three.)
options: The hostname should be fewer than 64 characters in length
The hostname should be written in all lower case characters
The hostname should contain no spaces
The hostname should end with a special character
The hostname should begin with a letter
answers: The hostname should be fewer than 64 characters in length
The hostname should contain no spaces
The hostname should begin with a letter
answerText: The hostname should be fewer than 64 characters in length; The hostname should contain no spaces; The hostname should begin with a letter.
explanation: В правилах курса hostname начинается с буквы, не содержит пробелов и имеет менее 64 символов. Только нижний регистр не обязателен. Заканчиваться специальным символом нельзя: последний символ должен быть буквой или цифрой.
explanationEn: Course hostname guidelines require a leading letter, no spaces and fewer than 64 characters. Lowercase-only spelling is not required. The name should end in a letter or digit, not a special character.

prompt: An administrator has just changed the IP address of an interface on an IOS device. What else must be done in order to apply those changes to the device?
options: Copy the running configuration to the startup configuration file.
Copy the information in the startup configuration file to the running configuration.
Reload the device and type yes when prompted to save the configuration.
Nothing must be done. Changes to the configuration on an IOS device take effect as soon as the command is typed correctly and the Enter key has been pressed.
answers: Nothing must be done. Changes to the configuration on an IOS device take effect as soon as the command is typed correctly and the Enter key has been pressed.
answerText: Nothing must be done. Changes to the configuration on an IOS device take effect as soon as the command is typed correctly and the Enter key has been pressed..
explanation: IP-адрес интерфейса изменяется в running-config сразу после принятия команды, поэтому отдельное apply или reload не требуется. copy running-config startup-config нужно для сохранения после перезагрузки, а обратное копирование загружает старую конфигурацию. Для фактической связи интерфейс также должен быть включён и подключён.
explanationEn: The interface IP changes in running-config as soon as the command is accepted, so no separate apply or reload is needed. copy running-config startup-config preserves it across reboot; copying the other way loads saved settings. Actual communication also requires an enabled, connected interface.

prompt: Which memory location on a Cisco router or switch will lose all content when the device is restarted?
explanation: RAM энергозависима: рабочая конфигурация и динамические таблицы теряются при отключении питания/перезапуске. ROM, Flash и NVRAM сохраняют свои данные, поэтому они не подходят под условие «lose all content».
explanationEn: RAM is volatile: active configuration and dynamic tables are lost on power cycling/restart. ROM, Flash and NVRAM retain their data, so they do not fit “lose all content”.

prompt: Why would a technician enter the command copy startup-config running-config ?
options: To remove all configurations from the switch
To save an active configuration to NVRAM
To copy an existing configuration into RAM
To make a changed configuration the new startup configuration
answers: To copy an existing configuration into RAM
answerText: To copy an existing configuration into RAM.
explanation: В copy сначала указан источник, потом назначение: startup-config → running-config загружает сохранённые команды в RAM. Команды объединяются с текущими, а не обязательно полностью заменяют их. Для сохранения в NVRAM направление было бы обратным; удаления конфигурации эта команда не выполняет.
explanationEn: copy lists source first and destination second: startup-config → running-config loads saved commands into RAM. They merge with the current configuration rather than necessarily replacing it completely. Saving to NVRAM uses the reverse direction; this command does not erase configuration.

prompt: Which two functions are provided to users by the context-sensitive help feature of the Cisco IOS CLI? (Choose two.)
options: Providing an error message when a wrong command is submitted
Displaying a list of all available commands within the current mode
Allowing the user to complete the remainder of an abbreviated command with the TAB key
Determining which option, keyword, or argument is available for the entered command
Selecting the best command to accomplish a task
answers: Displaying a list of all available commands within the current mode
Determining which option, keyword, or argument is available for the entered command
answerText: Displaying a list of all available commands within the current mode; Determining which option, keyword, or argument is available for the entered command.
explanation: Контекстная справка ? перечисляет команды текущего режима или допустимые следующие keywords/arguments после уже введённого текста. Tab — отдельное дополнение слова; сообщение об ошибке появляется после неверного ввода. Справка не выбирает за администратора лучший способ решения задачи.
explanationEn: Context-sensitive ? help lists commands available in the current mode or valid next keywords/arguments after entered text. Tab completion is a separate feature; an error message follows invalid input. Help does not choose the best solution to a task for the administrator.

prompt: Which memory location on a Cisco router or switch stores the startup configuration file?
explanation: В принятой в курсе архитектуре startup-config хранится в энергонезависимой NVRAM и читается при загрузке. RAM содержит действующую running-config; Flash обычно хранит образ IOS; ROM — начальный код загрузки/диагностики.
explanationEn: In the course architecture, nonvolatile NVRAM holds startup-config for loading at boot. RAM holds active running-config, Flash normally holds the IOS image, and ROM contains initial boot/diagnostic code.

prompt: A device receives a data link frame with data and processes and removes the Ethernet information. What information would be the next to be processed by the receiving device?
explanation: При decapsulation оболочки снимаются снаружи внутрь: Ethernet содержит IP-пакет, поэтому после Ethernet обрабатывается IP на internet/network layer. TCP/UDP находятся внутри IP, HTTP — ещё выше; UDP к internet layer не относится.
explanationEn: Decapsulation removes outer headers first: Ethernet contains an IP packet, so IP at the internet/network layer is next. TCP/UDP are inside IP and HTTP is above them; UDP is not an internet-layer protocol.

prompt: True or false? Frames exchanged between devices in different IP networks must be forwarded to a default gateway.
explanation: В обычной схеме курса хост видит по маске, что получатель в другой сети, и отправляет первый кадр локальному шлюзу. L2-коммутатор сам не выполняет IP-маршрутизацию. Уточнение: технически хост может иметь более специфичный маршрут через другой роутер; утверждение про default gateway предполагает обычный хост без такого маршрута.
explanationEn: In the course’s ordinary host setup, the mask shows that the destination is remote, so the first frame is addressed to the local gateway. A Layer 2 switch does not perform IP routing. Strictly, a host may have a more-specific route through another router; the default-gateway statement assumes the usual host without such a route.

prompt: True or False? Data Link addresses are physical so they never change in the data link frame from source to destination.
explanation: False: роутер снимает входной кадр и создаёт новый для следующего канала. Поэтому source/destination MAC относятся к текущему переходу, а не всему пути. Слово physical не делает MAC-пару в пересылаемых кадрах неизменной; IP конечных узлов обычно сохраняются при отсутствии NAT.
explanationEn: False: a router removes the incoming frame and builds another for the next link. Source/destination MAC addresses therefore describe the current hop, not the whole path. “Physical” does not make the MAC pair in forwarded frames immutable; endpoint IPs normally remain unchanged without NAT.

prompt: What is done to an IP packet before it is transmitted over the physical medium?
options: It is tagged with information guaranteeing reliable delivery.
It is segmented into smaller individual pieces.
It is encapsulated into a TCP segment.
It is encapsulated in a Layer 2 frame.
answers: It is encapsulated in a Layer 2 frame.
answerText: It is encapsulated in a Layer 2 frame..
explanation: Канальный уровень оборачивает IP-пакет в Layer 2 frame для конкретной среды, после чего физический уровень передаёт биты. TCP-сегмент находится внутри IP, а не снаружи. Ни L2-инкапсуляция, ни IP сами по себе не гарантируют надёжную доставку.
explanationEn: The data link layer encapsulates an IP packet in a Layer 2 frame appropriate to the medium, then the physical layer sends bits. A TCP segment is inside IP, not its outer wrapper. Neither this encapsulation nor IP itself guarantees reliable delivery.

prompt: What Layer 2 function does a router perform? (Choose three.)
options: Accepts a frame from a medium
Refers to its Layer 3 routing table for a matching destination network
Re-encapsulates the packet into a new frame
answers: Accepts a frame from a medium
Re-encapsulates the packet into a new frame
answerText: Accepts a frame from a medium; De-encapsulates the frame; Re-encapsulates the packet into a new frame.
explanation: К L2 относятся приём кадра, снятие его оболочки и создание нового кадра на выходе. Поиск destination network в routing table — решение L3, поэтому этот вариант не входит в три канальные функции, хотя роутер выполняет его между decapsulation и re-encapsulation.
explanationEn: Receiving a frame, removing its encapsulation and building an outgoing frame are Layer 2 functions. Looking up a destination network in the routing table is Layer 3, so it is excluded even though the router performs it between decapsulation and re-encapsulation.

prompt: A router boots and enters setup mode. What is the reason for this?
options: Cisco IOS is missing from flash memory.
The configuration file is missing from NVRAM.
The POST process has detected hardware failure.
answers: The configuration file is missing from NVRAM.
answerText: The configuration file is missing from NVRAM..
explanation: Setup mode предлагает первичную конфигурацию, когда IOS загрузился, но startup-config не найден в NVRAM. Повреждённый/отсутствующий IOS относится к проблеме загрузки ОС, а отказ POST — к аппаратной диагностике; они не объясняют обычный диалог настройки работающего IOS.
source: модули_10, Q1; тесты_exam_2, Q18; тесты_exam_6, Q26
explanationEn: Setup mode offers initial configuration when IOS has loaded but no startup-config is found in NVRAM. Missing/corrupt IOS is an operating-system boot problem and POST failure is hardware diagnosis; neither describes the normal setup dialog in running IOS.

prompt: Which command is used to encrypt all passwords in a router configuration file?
explanation: service password-encryption в global configuration скрывает поддерживаемые открытые пароли в конфигурации. enable secret задаёт только секрет privileged EXEC; enable password задаёт один пароль и сам по себе не скрывает все остальные. В классическом IOS это слабая обратимая Type 7, а не защита трафика или сильное шифрование всех секретов.
explanationEn: service password-encryption in global configuration obscures supported plaintext passwords in the configuration. enable secret sets only the privileged EXEC secret; enable password sets one password without obscuring others. In classic IOS this is weak reversible Type 7, not traffic encryption or strong protection for every secret.

prompt: Company policy requires using the most secure method to safeguard access to the privileged exec and configuration mode on the routers. The privileged exec password is trustknow1 . Which of the following router commands achieves the goal of providing the highest level of security?
explanation: Среди вариантов enable secret trustknow1 — корректный способ задать хешируемый секрет для privileged EXEC, откуда доступны настройки. enable password — более слабый старый вариант; service password-encryption не задаёт секрет и использует слабое скрытие открытых паролей. trustknow1 здесь значение из задачи, не рекомендация хорошего пароля.
explanationEn: Among the options, enable secret trustknow1 correctly sets a hashed secret for privileged EXEC, which gives access to configuration. enable password is the weaker legacy option; service password-encryption neither sets this secret nor provides strong protection. trustknow1 is the exercise value, not a recommended strong password.

prompt: What will be the response from the router after the command, "router(config)# hostname portsmouth \" is entered?
explanation: hostname portsmouth меняет имя router на portsmouth, но оставляет текущий global configuration mode. Поэтому получается portsmouth(config)#. Голый portsmouth# означал бы переход в privileged EXEC, которого команда hostname не делает; режима config-host для этой команды нет.
explanationEn: hostname portsmouth changes the name from router to portsmouth while retaining global configuration mode. The result is portsmouth(config)#. A bare portsmouth# would imply a mode change that hostname does not perform; there is no config-host mode for this command.

prompt: An administrator is configuring a new router to permit out-of-band management access. Which set of commands will allow the required login using a password of cisco ?
options: Router(config)# line vty 0 4 Router(config-line)# password manage Router(config-line)# exit Router(config)# enable password cisco
Router(config)# line vty 0 4 Router(config-line)# password cisco Router(config-line)# login
Router(config)# line console 0 Router(config-line)# password cisco Router(config-line)# login
Router(config)# line console 0 Router(config-line)# password cisco Router(config-line)# exit Router(config)# service password-encryption
answers: Router(config)# line console 0 Router(config-line)# password cisco Router(config-line)# login
answerText: Router(config)# line console 0 Router(config-line)# password cisco Router(config-line)# login.
explanation: Out-of-band доступ в данном случае идёт через console, поэтому нужны line console 0, password cisco и login. VTY обеспечивает сетевой удалённый доступ. Без login заданный line password не включит требуемую проверку; enable password защищает повышение прав, а не вход на console.
explanationEn: Here out-of-band access uses the console, requiring line console 0, password cisco and login. VTY is network remote access. Without login the line password does not enable the requested authentication; enable password protects privilege elevation, not console login.

prompt: Which command can be used on a Cisco router to display all interfaces, the IPv4 address assigned, and the current status?
explanation: show ip interface brief сводит все интерфейсы, IPv4-адреса, Status и Protocol в одну таблицу. ping проверяет достижимость, show ip route показывает маршруты, а show interface fa0/1 ограничивается одним интерфейсом и выдаёт подробности вместо общей сводки.
explanationEn: show ip interface brief summarizes all interfaces, IPv4 addresses, Status and Protocol in one table. ping tests reachability, show ip route lists routes, and show interface fa0/1 targets one interface rather than providing the requested overall summary.

prompt: Which CLI mode allows users to access all device commands, such as those used for configuration, management, and troubleshooting?
explanation: Privileged EXEC (#) даёт полный административный доступ и позволяет перейти к конфигурации через configure terminal. User EXEC (>) ограничен мониторингом; global/interface/line configuration — отдельные режимы изменения настроек. «Все команды» в формулировке означает полный доступ к возможностям, а не возможность вводить любую команду прямо в приглашении #.
explanationEn: Privileged EXEC (#) grants full administrative access and permits entry to configuration through configure terminal. User EXEC (>) offers limited monitoring; global/interface/line configuration are specific editing modes. “All commands” means access to all capabilities, not that every configuration command is entered directly at the # prompt.

prompt: What is the purpose of the startup configuration file on a Cisco router?
options: To facilitate the basic operation of the hardware components of a device
To contain the commands that are used to initially configure a router on startup
To contain the configuration commands that the router IOS is currently using
To provide a limited backup version of the IOS, in case the router cannot load the full featured IOS
answers: To contain the commands that are used to initially configure a router on startup
answerText: To contain the commands that are used to initially configure a router on startup.
explanation: startup-config содержит сохранённые команды, которые применяются при запуске IOS. Текущие используемые команды — running-config в RAM. Начальная аппаратная работа и резервная загрузочная среда относятся к ROM/bootstrap, а не к startup-config.
explanationEn: startup-config contains saved commands applied when IOS starts. Currently active commands are running-config in RAM. Initial hardware operation and a limited boot environment belong to ROM/bootstrap, not startup-config.

prompt: Which characteristic describes the default gateway of a host computer?
options: The logical address of the router interface on the same network as the host computer
The physical address of the switch interface connected to the host computer
The physical address of the router interface on the same network as the host computer
The logical address assigned to the switch interface connected to the router
answers: The logical address of the router interface on the same network as the host computer
answerText: The logical address of the router interface on the same network as the host computer.
explanation: Default gateway задаётся логическим IP-адресом локального интерфейса роутера: хост должен достигать его на своём канале перед отправкой в другие сети. MAC — физический адрес, который хост найдёт через ARP; IP L2-коммутатора для управления не заменяет маршрутизатор.
explanationEn: The default gateway is the logical IP address of the router interface on the host’s local network, reachable before forwarding to remote networks. Its MAC is a physical address resolved with ARP; a Layer 2 switch management IP is not a substitute for a router.

prompt: What is the purpose of the banner motd command?
options: It configures a message that will identify printed documents to LAN users.
It is a way that routers communicate the status of their links with one another.
It provides an easy way of communicating with any user attached to a router's LANs.
It provides a way to make announcements to those who log in to a router.
answers: It provides a way to make announcements to those who log in to a router.
answerText: It provides a way to make announcements to those who log in to a router..
explanation: banner motd показывает объявление подключающемуся к устройству пользователю, например предупреждение о допустимом доступе. Это не рассылка всем LAN-хостам, не сообщение о состоянии маршрутизаторских каналов и не идентификатор печатных документов.
explanationEn: banner motd displays an announcement to someone connecting to the device, such as an authorized-access notice. It is not a broadcast to all LAN users, a router link-status message or a printed-document identifier.

prompt: A technician is configuring a router to allow for all forms of management access. As part of each different type of access, the technician is trying to type the command login. Which configuration mode should be entered to do this task?
explanation: login — команда line configuration: сначала выбирают console, vty или aux, затем включают проверку входа на этой линии. Global configuration выбирает линию, но сам login вводится в (config-line)#; EXEC-режимы не предназначены для настройки line authentication.
explanationEn: login is a line-configuration command: select console, vty or aux first, then enable login authentication for that line. Global configuration selects the line, but login is entered at (config-line)#; EXEC modes do not configure line authentication.

prompt: What is stored in the NVRAM of a Cisco router?
explanation: В принятой в курсе архитектуре startup-config хранится в энергонезависимой NVRAM и читается при загрузке. RAM содержит действующую running-config; Flash обычно хранит образ IOS; ROM — начальный код загрузки/диагностики.
explanationEn: In the course architecture, nonvolatile NVRAM holds startup-config for loading at boot. RAM holds active running-config, Flash normally holds the IOS image, and ROM contains initial boot/diagnostic code.

prompt: Which statement regarding the service password-encryption command is true?
options: It is configured in privileged EXEC mode.
It encrypts only line mode passwords.
As soon as the service password-encryption command is entered, all currently set passwords formerly displayed in plain text are encrypted.
To see the passwords encrypted by the service password-encryption command in plain text, issue the no service password-encryption command.
answers: As soon as the service password-encryption command is entered, all currently set passwords formerly displayed in plain text are encrypted.
answerText: As soon as the service password-encryption command is entered, all currently set passwords formerly displayed in plain text are encrypted..
explanation: Команда service password-encryption в global configuration сразу скрывает поддерживаемые пароли, ранее показанные открыто, включая line passwords. Она не ограничивается одной линией. no service password-encryption отключает последующее преобразование, но не превращает уже записанные зашифрованные значения обратно в открытый текст.
explanationEn: service password-encryption runs in global configuration and immediately obscures supported existing plaintext passwords, including line passwords. It is not limited to one line. no service password-encryption stops future conversion but does not convert already encoded values back to plaintext.

prompt: Match the description with the associated IOS mode. limited number of basic monitoring commands user EXEC mode done the first entrance into the CLI of an IOS device accessed by entering the enable command privileged EXEC mode identified by a prompt ending with the # character changes made affect the operation of the device as a whole global configuration mode accessed by entering the configure terminal command
answers: user EXEC: базовый мониторинг и первый вход в CLI
global configuration: configure terminal, изменения всего устройства
answerText: user EXEC: базовый мониторинг и первый вход в CLI; privileged EXEC: enable, приглашение #; global configuration: configure terminal, изменения всего устройства.
explanation: User EXEC — первый вход и ограниченный мониторинг (>). enable даёт privileged EXEC (#), откуда доступны административные действия. configure terminal открывает global configuration ((config)#), где hostname и другие глобальные настройки влияют на устройство в целом. Это различие прав и назначения режимов, а не разные физические интерфейсы.
caution: Ответ
explanationEn: User EXEC is initial access and limited monitoring (>). enable enters privileged EXEC (#) for administrative actions. configure terminal enters global configuration ((config)#), where hostname and other global settings affect the device as a whole. These are privilege/function modes, not physical interfaces.

prompt: What are three characteristics of an SVI? (Choose three.)
options: It is designed as a security protocol to protect switch ports.
It is not associated with any physical interface on a switch.
It is a special interface that allows connectivity by different types of media.
It is required to allow connectivity by any device at any location.
It provides a means to remotely manage a switch.
It is associated with VLAN1 by default.
answers: It is not associated with any physical interface on a switch.
It provides a means to remotely manage a switch.
It is associated with VLAN1 by default.
answerText: It is not associated with any physical interface on a switch.; It provides a means to remotely manage a switch.; It is associated with VLAN1 by default..
explanation: SVI не имеет собственного физического порта, позволяет IP-управление коммутатором и в базовой конфигурации связан с VLAN 1. Это логический интерфейс, не security protocol и не переходник между типами среды. Обычная L2-пересылка пользовательских кадров не требует SVI.
explanationEn: An SVI has no dedicated physical port, enables IP management of the switch, and defaults to VLAN 1 in the basic configuration. It is a logical interface, not a security protocol or media converter. Ordinary Layer 2 forwarding of user frames does not require an SVI.

prompt: Which two host names follow the guidelines for naming conventions on Cisco IOS devices? (Choose two.)
explanation: RM-3-Switch-2A4 и SwBranch799 начинаются с буквы, заканчиваются буквой/цифрой и используют допустимые символы. Branch2! заканчивается !; Floor(15) содержит скобки; HO Floor 17 содержит пробелы. Дефисы внутри первого правильного имени допустимы.
explanationEn: RM-3-Switch-2A4 and SwBranch799 begin with a letter, end with a letter/digit and use permitted characters. Branch2! ends with !, Floor(15) contains parentheses, and HO Floor 17 contains spaces. Internal hyphens in the first correct name are allowed.

prompt: Which command or key combination allows a user to return to the previous level in the command hierarchy?
explanation: exit возвращает на один уровень иерархии, например из (config-if)# в (config)#. end и Ctrl+Z перескакивают прямо в privileged EXEC. Ctrl+C обычно прерывает текущую операцию/ввод и не является командой «на один уровень назад».
explanationEn: exit moves back one hierarchy level, for example from (config-if)# to (config)#. end and Ctrl+Z go directly to privileged EXEC. Ctrl+C normally interrupts an operation/input rather than serving as the one-level-back command.

prompt: What are two characteristics of RAM on a Cisco device? (Choose two.)
options: The configuration that is actively running on the device is stored in RAM.
The contents of RAM are lost during a power cycle.
RAM is a component in Cisco switches but not in Cisco routers.
RAM is able to store multiple versions of IOS and configuration files.
answers: The configuration that is actively running on the device is stored in RAM.
The contents of RAM are lost during a power cycle.
answerText: The configuration that is actively running on the device is stored in RAM.; The contents of RAM are lost during a power cycle..
explanation: RAM содержит активно используемую running-config и теряет данные при power cycle — обе выбранные характеристики верны. RAM есть и у роутеров, и у коммутаторов. Энергонезависимое хранение нескольких образов IOS относится прежде всего к Flash, не RAM.
explanationEn: RAM contains the active running-config and loses data during a power cycle, making both selected statements correct. Both routers and switches have RAM. Persistent storage of multiple IOS images primarily describes Flash, not RAM.

prompt: What function does pressing the Tab key have when entering a command in IOS?
options: It aborts the current command and returns to configuration mode.
It exits configuration mode and returns to user EXEC mode.
It moves the cursor to the beginning of the next line.
It completes the remainder of a partially typed word in a command.
answers: It completes the remainder of a partially typed word in a command.
answerText: It completes the remainder of a partially typed word in a command..
explanation: Tab дополняет частично введённое слово, если оно однозначно распознано, например conf до configure. При неоднозначном начале нужно ввести больше символов или использовать ?. Tab не завершает сеанс, не выходит из конфигурации и не отменяет команду.
explanationEn: Tab completes a partially entered word when it is unambiguous, such as conf to configure. Ambiguous input needs more letters or ? help. Tab does not end a session, leave configuration or cancel the command.

prompt: What command is used to verify the condition of the switch interfaces, including the status of the interfaces and a configured IP address?
explanation: show ip interface brief показывает Status/Protocol и назначенный IPv4 для интерфейсов, то есть именно требуемое состояние коммутатора. ipconfig — команда хоста, а ping/traceroute проверяют достижимость/путь и не выводят таблицу локальных интерфейсов IOS.
explanationEn: show ip interface brief displays interface Status/Protocol and assigned IPv4 addresses, matching the requested switch information. ipconfig is a host command; ping/traceroute test reachability/path rather than listing IOS local interfaces.

prompt: While trying to solve a network issue, a technician made multiple changes to the current router configuration file. The changes did not solve the problem and were not saved. What action can the technician take to discard the changes and work with the file in NVRAM?
options: Issue the reload command without saving the running configuration.
Delete the vlan.dat file and reboot the device.
Close and reopen the terminal emulation software.
Issue the copy startup-config running-config command.
answers: Issue the reload command without saving the running configuration.
answerText: Issue the reload command without saving the running configuration..
explanation: Перезагрузка без сохранения удалит несохранённые изменения RAM, затем загрузит startup-config из NVRAM. copy startup-config running-config лишь объединяет конфигурации и может оставить нежелательные команды. Перезапуск терминала не перезагружает роутер; удаление vlan.dat не восстанавливает его конфигурацию. В реальной сети reload прерывает работу, здесь это учебный выбор.
explanationEn: Reloading without saving discards unsaved RAM changes and then loads startup-config from NVRAM. copy startup-config running-config merges configurations and may leave unwanted commands. Restarting a terminal does not reboot the router; deleting vlan.dat does not restore its configuration. A real reload interrupts service; this is the exercise’s choice.

prompt: After making configuration changes on a Cisco switch, a network administrator issues a copy running-config startup-config command. What is the result of issuing this command?
options: The new configuration will be stored in flash memory.
The new configuration will be loaded if the switch is restarted.
The current IOS file will be replaced with the newly configured file.
The configuration changes will be removed and the original configuration will be restored.
answers: The new configuration will be loaded if the switch is restarted.
answerText: The new configuration will be loaded if the switch is restarted..
explanation: Команда сохраняет текущую running-config как startup-config, поэтому новые настройки загрузятся после перезапуска. Это не замена образа IOS и не откат к старым параметрам. В модели курса файл startup-config сохраняется в NVRAM, а не в хранилище образа IOS Flash.
explanationEn: The command saves the current running-config as startup-config, so the new settings load after restart. It neither replaces IOS nor restores old settings. In the course model startup-config is saved in NVRAM, not the Flash location used for the IOS image.

prompt: Refer to the exhibit. An administrator is trying to configure the switch but receives the error message that is displayed in the exhibit. What is the problem?
options: The entire command, configure terminal, must be used.
The administrator is already in global configuration mode.
The administrator must first enter privileged EXEC mode before issuing the command.
The administrator must connect via the console port to access global configuration mode.
answers: The administrator must first enter privileged EXEC mode before issuing the command.
answerText: The administrator must first enter privileged EXEC mode before issuing the command..
explanation: Сохранённый ответ предполагает приглашение Switch>: configure terminal доступна из privileged EXEC, поэтому сначала нужен enable. Однозначное сокращение conf t допустимо, console не является обязательным способом входа в конфигурацию. Сам рисунок с ошибкой здесь отсутствует, поэтому конкретный вывод нельзя независимо подтвердить.
caution: Нужен исходный рисунок/файл активности; сохранённый ответ не подтверждён независимо.
source: тесты_exam_0, Q29; тесты_exam_6, Q5; тесты_exam_7, Q14
explanationEn: The saved answer assumes a Switch> prompt: configure terminal requires privileged EXEC, so enable is needed first. An unambiguous abbreviation such as conf t is allowed, and console access is not mandatory for configuration. The actual error exhibit is missing here, so its specific diagnosis cannot be independently confirmed.

prompt: Open the PT Activity. Perform the tasks in the activity instructions and then answer the question. What is the IP address of the switch virtual interface (SVI) on Switch0?
explanation: 192.168.5.10 — сохранённый ответ для конкретного PT-файла, не адрес по умолчанию у SVI. Его нужно проверить на Switch0 командой show ip interface brief или show running-config в interface vlan. Без исходной активности выбирать между перечисленными IP по теории невозможно; задача исключена из автоматического квиза.
caution: Нужен исходный рисунок/файл активности; сохранённый ответ не подтверждён независимо.
explanationEn: 192.168.5.10 is the saved answer for that PT activity, not a default SVI address. Verify it on Switch0 using show ip interface brief or show running-config under interface vlan. Without the activity, theory cannot distinguish these IPs; the question is excluded from the automatic quiz.

prompt: Within a production network, what is the purpose of configuring a switch with a default gateway address?
options: Hosts that are connected to the switch can use the switch default gateway address to forward packets to a remote destination.
A switch must have a default gateway to be accessible by Telnet and SSH.
The default gateway address is used to forward packets originating from the switch to remote networks.
It provides a next-hop address for all traffic that flows through the switch.
answers: The default gateway address is used to forward packets originating from the switch to remote networks.
answerText: The default gateway address is used to forward packets originating from the switch to remote networks..
explanation: Шлюз L2-коммутатора обслуживает пакеты, источником которых является сам коммутатор: например SSH-ответ администратору в другой сети. Он не подменяет default gateway на подключённых ПК и не используется для каждого транзитного кадра. Управление из той же подсети возможно без шлюза.
explanationEn: A Layer 2 switch gateway serves packets originating from the switch itself, such as SSH replies to an administrator on another subnet. It does not replace gateways configured on attached PCs or handle every transit frame. Same-subnet management can work without a gateway.

prompt: A computer can access devices on the same network but cannot access devices on other networks. What is the probable cause of this problem?
options: The cable is not connected properly to the NIC.
The computer has an invalid IP address.
The computer has an incorrect subnet mask.
The computer has an invalid default gateway address.
answers: The computer has an invalid default gateway address.
answerText: The computer has an invalid default gateway address..
explanation: В сценарии наиболее вероятен неверный default gateway: локальные пакеты доставляются напрямую, удалённые требуют роутера. Работа локальной сети делает обрыв кабеля менее вероятным. Неверная маска тоже способна дать похожие симптомы, поэтому это выбор наиболее подходящего варианта, а не окончательный диагноз без проверки IP/mask/gateway.
explanationEn: An invalid default gateway best fits this scenario: local packets are delivered directly, while remote destinations need a router. Working local communication makes a disconnected cable less likely. A wrong mask can also cause similar symptoms, so this is the best listed explanation, not a definitive diagnosis without checking IP/mask/gateway.

prompt: Match the phases to the functions during the boot up process of a Cisco router. A phase 1 perform the POST and load the bootstrap program done B phase 2 locate and load the Cisco IOS software C phase 3 locate and load the startup configuration file
answerText: 1: POST и bootstrap; 2: поиск и загрузка IOS; 3: поиск и загрузка startup-config.
explanation: Сначала POST проверяет оборудование и bootstrap начинает загрузку; затем находится и запускается IOS; после этого IOS читает startup-config. Нельзя применить обычные команды конфигурации до запуска ОС, поэтому фазы 2 и 3 не взаимозаменяемы.
caution: Ответ
explanationEn: POST checks hardware and the bootstrap starts booting first; next IOS is located and loaded; then IOS reads startup-config. Normal configuration commands cannot be applied before the operating system runs, so phases 2 and 3 cannot be reversed.

prompt: What are two functions of NVRAM? (Choose two.)
options: to retain contents when power is removed
to store the startup configuration file
to contain the running configuration file
answers: to retain contents when power is removed
to store the startup configuration file
answerText: to retain contents when power is removed; to store the startup configuration file.
explanation: NVRAM сохраняет содержимое без питания и хранит startup-config. Routing table, ARP table и running-config — изменяемые рабочие данные в RAM. Поэтому из списка верны сохранность без питания и стартовая конфигурация.
explanationEn: NVRAM retains its contents without power and stores startup-config. Routing table, ARP table and running-config are active working data in RAM. Thus power-independent retention and startup configuration are the two correct choices.

prompt: The global configuration command ip default-gateway 172.16.100.1 is applied to a switch. What is the effect of this command?
options: The switch will have a management interface with the address 172.16.100.1.
The switch can be remotely managed from a host on another network.
The switch can communicate with other hosts on the 172.16.100.0 network.
The switch is limited to sending and receiving frames to and from the gateway 172.16.100.1.
answers: The switch can be remotely managed from a host on another network.
answerText: The switch can be remotely managed from a host on another network..
explanation: ip default-gateway 172.16.100.1 задаёт роутер для исходящего управления L2-коммутатора, чтобы он мог ответить администратору из другой сети. Команда не назначает 172.16.100.1 самому SVI и не ограничивает все кадры одним адресатом. Для результата также нужны настроенный SVI, доступный роутер и разрешённый удалённый доступ.
explanationEn: ip default-gateway 172.16.100.1 sets the router for the Layer 2 switch’s own outbound traffic, allowing replies to administrators on another subnet. It neither assigns 172.16.100.1 to the SVI nor restricts all frames to one destination. A configured SVI, reachable router and enabled management access are also required.

prompt: Match the configuration mode with the command that is available in that mode. A R1(config-line)# login done B R1(config)# interface fastethernet 0/0 C R1# copy running-config startup-config D R1> enable
answerText: R1(config-line)# → login; R1(config)# → interface fastethernet 0/0; R1# → copy running-config startup-config; R1> → enable.
explanation: login относится к выбранной линии и вводится в (config-line)#. interface fastethernet 0/0 выбирает интерфейс из (config)#. copy running-config startup-config — административная EXEC-команда в #. enable вводится из > для повышения прав. Важен не только текст команды, но и режим приглашения.
caution: Ответ
explanationEn: login applies to a selected line at (config-line)#. interface fastethernet 0/0 selects an interface from (config)#. copy running-config startup-config is an administrative EXEC command at #. enable is entered from > to elevate privileges. The prompt mode matters as well as the command text.

prompt: Refer to the exhibit. Consider the IP address configuration shown from PC1. What is a description of the default gateway address?
options: It is the IP address of the Router1 interface that connects the company to the Internet.
It is the IP address of the Router1 interface that connects the PC1 LAN to Router1.
It is the IP address of Switch1 that connects PC1 to other devices on the same LAN.
It is the IP address of the ISP network device located in the cloud.
answers: It is the IP address of the Router1 interface that connects the PC1 LAN to Router1.
answerText: It is the IP address of the Router1 interface that connects the PC1 LAN to Router1..
explanation: По смыслу default gateway — IP интерфейса Router1, подключённого к LAN PC1. Хост должен сначала добраться до него локально; WAN-интерфейс, устройство ISP и IP управления Switch1 не подходят. Связь конкретных устройств на рисунке здесь не проверяется, потому что исходный exhibit отсутствует.
caution: Нужен исходный рисунок/файл активности; сохранённый ответ не подтверждён независимо.
explanationEn: By definition, the default gateway is the IP of Router1’s interface on PC1’s LAN. The host must reach it locally first; Router1’s WAN interface, an ISP device and Switch1’s management IP do not fit. The specific diagram connections cannot be verified here because the exhibit is absent.

prompt: What will happen if the default gateway address is incorrectly configured on a host?
options: The host cannot communicate with other hosts in the local network.
The switch will not forward packets initiated by the host.
The host will have to use ARP to determine the correct address of the default gateway.
The host cannot communicate with hosts in other networks.
A ping from the host to 127.0.0.1 would not be successful.
answers: The host cannot communicate with hosts in other networks.
answerText: The host cannot communicate with hosts in other networks..
explanation: Неверный шлюз мешает доставлять пакеты в другие сети, но обычно не мешает прямому обмену внутри подсети и loopback ping 127.0.0.1. ARP разрешает заданный IP в MAC, а не исправляет ошибочный IP шлюза. Коммутатор не прекращает L2-пересылку из-за этой настройки хоста.
explanationEn: A wrong gateway prevents reaching other networks but normally leaves direct same-subnet traffic and loopback ping 127.0.0.1 working. ARP resolves the configured IP to a MAC; it does not discover and fix a wrong gateway IP. The switch does not stop Layer 2 forwarding because of the host setting.

prompt: What is the effect of using the Router# copy running-config startup-config command on a router?
options: The contents of ROM will change.
The contents of RAM will change.
The contents of NVRAM will change.
The contents of flash will change.
answers: The contents of NVRAM will change.
answerText: The contents of NVRAM will change..
explanation: В copy running-config startup-config источник — рабочая конфигурация RAM, назначение — startup-config в NVRAM. Поэтому изменяется содержимое NVRAM. Команда не перезаписывает ROM, образ IOS во Flash или саму конфигурацию-источник в RAM.
explanationEn: In copy running-config startup-config, the source is the active RAM configuration and the destination is startup-config in NVRAM. Therefore NVRAM changes. The command does not overwrite ROM, the IOS image in Flash or the source configuration in RAM.

prompt: Which command can an administrator execute to determine what interface a router will use to reach remote networks?
explanation: show ip route показывает destination prefixes, next hop и выходной интерфейс, поэтому по нему выбирают путь к удалённой сети. show arp сопоставляет локальные IP/MAC; show interfaces описывает состояние портов; show protocols не заменяет таблицу маршрутов назначения.
explanationEn: show ip route lists destination prefixes, next hops and exit interfaces, allowing the path to a remote network to be identified. show arp maps local IP/MAC pairs, show interfaces describes port status, and show protocols does not replace the destination routing table.

prompt: What information about a Cisco router can be verified using the show version command?
options: the routing protocol version that is enabled
the value of the configuration register
the operational status of serial interfaces
the administrative distance used to reach networks
answers: the value of the configuration register
answerText: the value of the configuration register.
explanation: show version выводит сведения об IOS, аппаратуре и загрузке, включая configuration register на соответствующих роутерах. Состояние serial смотрят через show interfaces; administrative distance — в маршрутах; сведения о протоколах маршрутизации — другими show-командами.
explanationEn: show version reports IOS, hardware and boot information, including the configuration register on relevant routers. Serial status belongs in show interfaces, administrative distance in route information, and routing-protocol details in other show commands.

prompt: Refer to the exhibit. An administrator is testing connectivity to a remote device with the IP address 10.1.1.1. What does the output of this command indicate?
options: Connectivity to the remote device was successful.
A router along the path did not have a route to the destination.
A ping packet is being blocked by a security device along the path.
The connection timed out while waiting for a reply from the remote device.
answers: A router along the path did not have a route to the destination.
answerText: A router along the path did not have a route to the destination..
explanation: Сохранённый ответ связывает вывод с отсутствием маршрута. В IOS ping символ U означает ICMP Destination Unreachable, ! — успешный ответ, . — таймаут. Однако U не доказывает одну-единственную причину: unreachable имеет разные коды. Без самого вывода и ICMP-кода утверждать, какой роутер не имел маршрута, нельзя; карточка остаётся вне автоматического квиза.
caution: Нужен исходный рисунок/файл активности; сохранённый ответ не подтверждён независимо.
explanationEn: The saved answer interprets the output as a missing route. IOS ping uses U for ICMP Destination Unreachable, ! for success and . for timeout. However, U alone does not prove one cause because unreachable has multiple codes. Without the output and ICMP code, a specific missing-route diagnosis is unverified; this card stays outside the automatic quiz.

prompt: A network technician is troubleshooting an issue and needs to verify the IP addresses of all interfaces on a router. What is the best command to use to accomplish the task?
explanation: Для списка IP всех интерфейсов на Cisco-роутере подходит show ip interface brief. nslookup обращается к DNS; ipconfig getifaddr en0 — команда другой ОС для одного интерфейса; show ip route выводит маршруты, а не полную таблицу IP/состояний интерфейсов.
explanationEn: show ip interface brief is the Cisco router command for an overview of all interface IPs. nslookup queries DNS; ipconfig getifaddr en0 is a different operating system’s command for one interface; show ip route lists routes rather than a full interface IP/status summary.

prompt: What does a router do when it receives a Layer 2 frame over the network medium?
options: re-encapsulates the packet into a new frame
forwards the new frame appropriate to the medium of that segment of the physical network
explanation: После приёма подходящего L2-кадра роутер снимает его заголовок/трейлер, чтобы получить IP-пакет. Только затем ищется маршрут; после выбора выхода создаётся новый кадр и передаётся дальше. Вопрос спрашивает непосредственное действие после получения, поэтому decapsulation предшествует другим вариантам.
explanationEn: After accepting the relevant Layer 2 frame, the router removes its header/trailer to access the IP packet. It then looks up the route, builds an outgoing frame and forwards it. The question asks the immediate action on receipt, so decapsulation precedes the other listed steps.

prompt: If the default gateway is configured incorrectly on the host, what is the impact on communications?
options: The host is unable to communicate on the local network.
The host can communicate with other hosts on the local network, but is unable to communicate with hosts on remote networks.
The host can communicate with other hosts on remote networks, but is unable to communicate with hosts on the local network.
There is no impact on communications.
answers: The host can communicate with other hosts on the local network, but is unable to communicate with hosts on remote networks.
answerText: The host can communicate with other hosts on the local network, but is unable to communicate with hosts on remote networks..
explanation: Локальный получатель находится по маске и ARP без участия шлюза, поэтому обмен внутри своей сети сохраняется. Пакеты в удалённые сети направляются неверному шлюзу и не доставляются обычным путём. Следовательно неверны варианты «не работает локально» и «никакого влияния».
explanationEn: The host identifies a local destination using its mask and resolves it with ARP without using a gateway, so same-network communication remains possible. Remote packets are sent to the wrong gateway and fail through the normal path. Therefore “local communication fails” and “no impact” are incorrect.

prompt: Which two statements describe features of an IPv4 routing table on a router? (Choose two.)
options: The netstat -r command can be used to display the routing table of a router.
Directly connected interfaces will have two route source codes in the routing table: C and S.
It stores information about routes derived from the active router interfaces.
If there are two or more possible routes to the same destination, the route associated with the higher metric value is included in the routing table.
If a default static route is configured in the router, an entry will be included in the routing table with source code S.
The routing table lists the MAC addresses of each active interface.
answers: It stores information about routes derived from the active router interfaces.
If a default static route is configured in the router, an entry will be included in the routing table with source code S.
answerText: It stores information about routes derived from the active router interfaces.; If a default static route is configured in the router, an entry will be included in the routing table with source code S..
explanation: Активные адресованные интерфейсы дают непосредственно подключённые маршруты, а установленный статический default route имеет код S (часто S*). Локальные коды — C и L, не C и S; MAC находятся в ARP/канальных таблицах. В IOS таблицу смотрят show ip route, не netstat -r. Для сопоставимых маршрутов одного протокола обычно предпочтительна меньшая метрика, не большая.
explanationEn: Active addressed interfaces contribute directly connected routes, and an installed static default route has code S (often S*). Local route codes are C and L, not C and S; MAC addresses belong to ARP/link-layer tables. IOS uses show ip route, not netstat -r. Comparable routes from one protocol normally prefer a lower metric, not a higher one.

prompt: Refer to the exhibit. If PC1 is sending a packet to PC2 and routing has been configured between the two routers, what will R1 do with the Ethernet frame header attached by PC1?
options: nothing, because the router has a route to the destination network
remove the Ethernet header and configure a new Layer 2 header before sending it out S0/0/0
open the header and replace the destination MAC address with a new one
open the header and use it to determine whether the data is to be sent out S0/0/0
answers: remove the Ethernet header and configure a new Layer 2 header before sending it out S0/0/0
answerText: remove the Ethernet header and configure a new Layer 2 header before sending it out S0/0/0.
explanation: Роутер удаляет входную Ethernet-оболочку и заново инкапсулирует IP-пакет для выходного Serial-интерфейса.
